verdict.rationale: ELSTER is an online tax-filing portal, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows only automatic tax-return creation in MeinELSTER+ and a guided step-by-step process. Neither is described as AI-generated insight or suggestions drawn from the user's data, so both count as adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
